name: a standing that is not one of the three words
why: measures.standing is one of a short list: hit, pending or miss, or empty when a measure has no bar to be judged against. The tables say so (schema.sql) and the page's own test says so, so a value outside the list written into the snapshot leaves the repo red and has to be hand-edited before it can ship.
fails: measures[0].standing is not one of hit, pending, miss
